Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.

On this basis we propose: EUR 31.40 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

we can move a bit:

If you still want a lower price, you really gotta tell me what volume you can commit to.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. We simply cannot go below 31.50 for 14 days payment and 42 days lead time without a volume commitment. If you really need to go lower, you have to tell me what volume you can commit to. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please keep in mind that our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Also, please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We are really keen to work together and build a great long-term partnership with you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
